answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. A farm faking 532 aliases needs 532 separate deposit records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Seed bank deposit record with accession number chain is the check: deposits made to one seed bank across seasons. Watch the sparrow: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the knoll bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the tide audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
